source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free unbranded handheld console in a stable three-quarter front view with a blank screen, one D-pad, exactly two action buttons, two menu buttons, four speaker slots, one power light, and one broken shadow.

process_strategy: Reserve the screen, controls, speaker, light, and shadow in pale construction before shaping the console shell, preserve every footprint through the black-marker and color passes, keep the blank display free of game art or text, and limit the final panel to outline, fill, highlight, and shadow cleanup.

final_elements.description: One chunky handheld console with rounded corners, a raised blank-screen bezel, and a visible right-side thickness plane.

final_elements.description: A face-free control layout with one cross-shaped D-pad, exactly two round action buttons, two small oval menu buttons, exactly four short speaker slots, one power light, and two diagonal blank-screen highlight gaps.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline and broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces all established shell, bezel, control, speaker, light, highlight, and shadow boundaries.

final_elements.name: cobalt raspberry mustard teal and warm-gray marker fills

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free handheld console, one three-quarter front view, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
The blank screen, D-pad, two action buttons, two menu buttons, four speaker slots, power light, and side thickness must remain in the same positions after they appear.
Do not introduce a control, slot, light, bezel edge, screen highlight, shadow shape, or color area in the final panel.
Do not add game characters, pixels, words, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, hands, cables, cartridges, face features, sticker borders, or badge frames.
The screen must stay blank apart from the two established diagonal paper-highlight gaps.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean icon art, polished product rendering, or glossy AI poster art.
